title: Tone & visual-weight pass for onboarding illustrations and icon language (dark-mode + a11y)
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Improve clarity and semantic legibility of onboarding/quickstart visuals for dark and high-contrast environments without changing overall brand tone. This includes: 1) rebalancing visual weight across primary illustrations so focal actions (CTA, key UI areas) pop in low-light contexts; 2) replacing ambiguous glyphs with a consistent symbol language for status/permission/connection metaphors; 3) ensuring WCAG AA contrast for key foreground elements on both dark tokens and inverted assets; 4) producing updated product screenshots and copy-ready export sets for release notes and docs. Deliverables: new Figma component variants, icon sprite (SVG + optimized PNG fallbacks), updated screenshots for Quickstart flows, QA checklist for engineering and docs teams.

2026-03-06 - Accessibility review (Ethan Ross): Automated contrast tests show 2 icon glyphs failing AA on 14px; recommendation: increase stroke weight from 1.25px to 1.5px and use semantic fill for 'link' glyph.
